order_note: No predecessor. SQL 118 replaces SQL 117 (never applied; retired after its staging apply run 40434533070 rolled back because the new table kept the grants the database's default privileges give a new table). SQL 118 needs public.tenants, public.tenant_users, public.tenant_pricing_audit (SQL 96), public.is_platform_owner() and public.aws_tenants_member_column_guard() (SQL 102), all present in production since 2026-10-20. It creates public.tenant_deactivations (RLS on, no policy, no grant: every non-owner grant, default-privilege grants included, is revoked; owned by checksops_admin) and six functions (five SECURITY DEFINER platform-owner functions and the IMMUTABLE aws_tenant_activity_tables(); EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to checksops and authenticated, as SQL 102). It changes no existing function, policy, grant, column or row. The API that calls it (tenant-billing-admin tenants-deactivated, tenant-deactivate, tenant-reactivate, tenant-activity and tenant-delete) is already live in production since overlay run 40425235000 and answers 503 tenant_lifecycle_missing until SQL 118 is applied. If the read-only inspect reports already_applied true nothing is applied.
